content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble confirming compatibility between two devices: [company_name] [product_name] [article_no], which has connectors for SD card, LAN, and expansion modules, and a planned purchase of [company_name] [article_no] display extension from [url]. Are these compatible, and how should I connect them? I read the display extension may only connect via LAN port, but I'm unsure if the PLC supports this. If not, what display should I consider? Also, where can I find detailed datasheets for both products? Picture attached. Thanks in advance for your assistance!

They should be compatible. The text display [product_name] ([article_no]) is suitable for use with [product_name] 8 series ([article_no] to [article_no]). You can verify this at [url]. Communication uses Profinet protocol. Thank you.

The [product_name] is designed for [product_name] 8 programmable controllers. You connect it to the base module using a standard Ethernet cable. The display has two LAN ports that work as a switch. The base module you have is a version [version_no].
This information was very helpful to us. Thanks to both of you for your support! Have a great day!
I am unable to locate the manual for your [product_name] on the [company_name] website anymore. The ZIP file is too large for me to attach, so I have uploaded it to my cloud. Here is the link: [url]
